solidworks_view_add_perspective.doc: Add perspective to the model view. It modifies the view only; it takes no arguments, returns nothing, and the reference documents no precondition for turning perspective on.

solidworks_view_remove_perspective.doc: Remove perspective from the model view. It modifies the view only; it takes no arguments, returns nothing, and the reference documents no precondition for turning perspective off.

solidworks_view_start_dynamics.doc: Start fast dynamic view changes so that following rotations redraw faster. It modifies how the view redraws only; use it at the beginning of dynamic view changes and pair it with the stop-dynamics call, which restores the previous display mode.

solidworks_view_stop_dynamics.doc: Stop dynamic view changes and restore the previous display mode. It modifies the view only; call it at the end of dynamic motion to return to the earlier display mode, then redraw the graphics area so the display is recalculated.

solidworks_view_get_next.doc: Get the next model view in the document, or nothing when the list of views ends. Read-only; walk the views by calling it repeatedly, and a null result means you have reached the end of the list.

solidworks_simulation_get_buckling_load_.doc: Get the buckling load factors of a solved buckling study. Read-only; it passes through what the results object returns, no reference page documents the exact result form, and the factor count comes back through an output argument rather than the return value.

solidworks_get_view_model_doc.doc: Get the document that owns the model view. Read-only; it takes no arguments and returns the document object behind the view rather than a name or a path.

solidworks_collect_view_evidence.doc: Read the state of the model view as one evidence record. Read-only; the record holds the window frame, display mode, HLR quality, scale, perspective flag, graphics-update and zebra-stripe flags, xor highlight, and whether a camera and an orientation are present.

solidworks_simulation_get_worst_jacobian.doc: Get the worst jacobian ratio of the mesh as a mesh-distortion reading. Read-only; it takes no arguments and returns a plain ratio, and no reference page documents a valid range for it.

solidworks_simulation_is_component_faile.doc: Report whether one component of the mesh failed meshing. Read-only; it passes the component name to the boolean member and returns that verdict, and no reference page documents what form the name must take.

params.component_name: Name of the component to check; the reference documents this parameter only as a string, with no format. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_sketch_trim.doc: Trim the selected sketch entities. It modifies the active sketch; how many segments you must select depends on the option, with closest taking exactly one and corner exactly two.

params.selection: Declarative selection of the sketch segment: 'index:<n>' for the n-th segment of the current sketch, several as a comma list, or '__current_selection__' to reuse the current selection.
params.option: Trim flavour: closest takes one segment and corner takes two, and the other accepted values are two_entities, entity_point, entities, outside and inside. Defaults to 'closest'.
params.x_mm: Trim point X in millimetres, used by the options that take a point. Defaults to 0.0.
params.y_mm: Trim point Y in millimetres. Defaults to 0.0.

solidworks_sketch_extend.doc: Extend the selected sketch entity to the nearest entity. It modifies the active sketch and needs the segment to extend already selected; the extend-to point is used by the flavours that take one.

params.selection: Declarative selection of the sketch segment: 'index:<n>' for the n-th segment of the current sketch, several as a comma list, or '__current_selection__' to reuse the current selection.
params.x_mm: Extend-to X in millimetres. Defaults to 0.0.
params.y_mm: Extend-to Y in millimetres. Defaults to 0.0.

solidworks_sketch_offset.doc: Offset the selected sketch entities by a distance. It modifies the active sketch; the cap-end and construction options take the official enum values, and a chain selection follows the whole connected chain instead of the picked segment alone.

params.selection: Declarative selection of the sketch entities: 'index:<n>' for the n-th segment of the current sketch, several as a comma list, or '__current_selection__' to reuse the current selection.
params.both_directions: Whether to offset to both sides of the entities. Defaults to false.
params.chain: Whether to select the whole chain of entities. Defaults to true.
params.cap_ends: How to cap the ends of an open offset: none, arc or line. Defaults to 'none'.
params.make_construction: Which result to make construction geometry: dont, orig, offs or both. Defaults to 'dont'.
params.add_dimensions: Whether to add dimensions to the offset result. Defaults to false.

solidworks_sketch_fillet.doc: Create a fillet between two intersecting sketch segments. It modifies the active sketch and needs exactly those two segments selected; the radius is given in millimetres.

params.selection: Declarative selection of the two segments: 'index:<n>' for a segment of the current sketch, several as a comma list, or '__current_selection__' to reuse the current selection.
params.constrained_corners: Corner-constraint option passed straight to the reference call. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_sketch_linear_pattern.doc: Create a linear sketch pattern of the selected entities. It modifies the active sketch; both counts are instance counts rather than coordinates, and both angles are given in degrees and converted once at the boundary.

params.selection: Declarative selection of the sketch entities: 'index:<n>' for the n-th segment of the current sketch, several as a comma list, or '__current_selection__' to reuse the current selection.
params.x_count: Number of instances along X, a count and not a coordinate. Defaults to 2.
params.y_count: Number of instances along Y, a count and not a coordinate. Defaults to 1.
params.spacing_x_mm: Spacing along X in millimetres. Defaults to 10.0.
params.spacing_y_mm: Spacing along Y in millimetres. Defaults to 0.0.
params.angle_x_deg: Pattern angle about X in degrees, converted once at the boundary. Defaults to 0.0.
params.angle_y_deg: Pattern angle about Y in degrees. Defaults to 0.0.
params.delete_instances: Instance numbers to skip, as a comma list such as '2,3'. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_sketch_circular_pattern.doc: Create a circular sketch pattern of the selected entities. It modifies the active sketch; the instances follow an arc that you define by radius and angle, and skipped instance numbers are left out of the pattern.

params.selection: Declarative selection of the sketch entities: 'index:<n>' for the n-th segment of the current sketch, several as a comma list, or '__current_selection__' to reuse the current selection.
params.arc_radius_mm: Radius of the arc the instances follow, in millimetres. Defaults to 20.0.
params.arc_angle_deg: Angle of the arc the instances follow, in degrees. Defaults to 360.0.
params.pattern_spacing_deg: Spacing between instances, in degrees. Defaults to 0.0.
params.pattern_rotate: Whether to rotate the instances as they are patterned. Defaults to true.
params.delete_instances: Instance numbers to skip, as a comma list. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_sketch_add_arc.doc: Draw an arc in the active sketch from a centre, a start point and an end point. It modifies the sketch; the coordinates are millimetres from the sketch origin in the sketch plane, which is the documented exception to naming geometry for selection.

params.center_x_mm: Centre X in millimetres, measured from the sketch origin.
params.center_y_mm: Centre Y in millimetres, measured from the sketch origin.
params.direction: Arc direction as the reference parameter takes it, clockwise or counter-clockwise. Defaults to 1.

solidworks_sketch_add_ellipse.doc: Draw a full ellipse in the active sketch from its centre, a major-axis point and a minor-axis point. It modifies the sketch; it draws the full ellipse and never an elliptical arc, and the coordinates are millimetres in the sketch plane.

params.z_mm: Sketch plane Z in millimetres. Defaults to 0.0.

solidworks_sketch_add_polygon.doc: Draw a regular polygon in the active sketch, sized by its inscribed-circle radius. It modifies the sketch; the coordinates are millimetres from the sketch origin, and the side count must be at least three.

params.sides: Number of sides, at least 3. Defaults to 6.

solidworks_sketch_add_slot.doc: Draw a straight slot in the active sketch from two centre points plus a radius. It modifies the sketch; the coordinates are millimetres from the sketch origin, and the radius is half the slot width.

params.radius_mm: Slot radius, which is half the slot width, in millimetres.

solidworks_sketch_add_centerline.doc: Draw a centreline in the active sketch. It modifies the sketch; a centreline can act as the axis of a revolve, so this call is a prerequisite for revolve features and not only a construction line, and the coordinates are millimetres from the sketch origin.

params.z_mm: Sketch plane Z in millimetres. Defaults to 0.0.
